title.zh: 工作進度與績效檢討匯報

slide_title.zh: 本月/本季核心進度摘要 (Executive Summary)

zh: 核心 KPI 達成率：已完成整體目標的 [X]%
三大重點專案：[專案A] 已完工，[專案B] 按時推進中
今日匯報目的：總結成果、剖析瓶頸，並確認下階段資源分配
en: Core KPI Achievement: Completed [X]% of overall targets
Top 3 Projects: [Project A] delivered, [Project B] on track
Objective: Summarize results, analyze bottlenecks, and align resources

speaker_notes.zh: 老闆/各位主管好，今天的進度匯報將重點呈現我們本月的核心產出、目前面臨的挑戰，以及下一個階段需要獲得的資源支援，確保目標按時交付。
speaker_notes.en: Good morning/afternoon. Today's review will focus on our core deliverables this month, current challenges, and the resources needed for the next phase to ensure on-time delivery.

slide_title.zh: 關鍵指標與 KPI 達成狀況

zh: 指標一 (例如：營收/進度)：實際 [數字] vs 目標 [數字] (超額達成/落後)
指標二 (例如：品質/效率)：流程時間縮短 [X]%，客訴/錯誤率下降 [X]%
指標三 (例如：預算執行)：累積支出於控制範圍內，無超支風險
en: Metric 2 (e.g., Quality/Efficiency): Process time reduced by [X]%, Error rate dropped by [X]%
Metric 3 (e.g., Budget): Cumulative spend within control, no overspend risk

speaker_notes.zh: 從數據來看，我們在本月的核心指標呈現穩定成長，特別是在效率提升方面有顯著效果；預算與資源使用也都控制在合規範圍內。
speaker_notes.en: Looking at the data, our core metrics show steady growth this month, particularly in efficiency gains. Budget and resource utilization remain strictly within compliance limits.

zh: 已完成事項：完成 [關鍵任務 1] 與 [關鍵任務 2] 之驗收
進行中事項：[專案名稱] 目前進度 [X]%，預計 [日期] 前交付
延遲/風險事項：[專案名稱] 略有延遲，已啟動備援方案 (Mitigation Plan)
en: In Progress: [Project Name] is [X]% complete, expected delivery by [Date]
Delayed/At Risk: [Project Name] slightly delayed, mitigation plan activated

speaker_notes.zh: 主要專案大多按照預定時程推進。針對稍微延遲的項目，我們已經找出原因並擬定補救措施，預計可以在下個週期補齊進度。
speaker_notes.en: Most major projects are progressing according to schedule. For the slightly delayed items, we have identified the root causes and implemented mitigation plans to catch up in the next cycle.

slide_title.zh: 遭遇挑戰與根本原因分析 (Root Cause)

zh: 主要瓶頸：跨部門溝通卡關 / 外部廠商時程延誤 / 人力資源緊繃
根本原因：缺乏標準作業流程 (SOP) / 需求規格初期未對齊
應對措施：已建立臨時協調機制，並調整作業優先順序
en: Main Bottleneck: Cross-functional silos / Vendor delays / Resource constraints
Root Cause: Lack of standard operating procedures (SOP) / Misaligned initial requirements
Countermeasure: Established ad-hoc coordination and reprioritized tasks

speaker_notes.zh: 我們不只看表面問題，更深入分析了根本原因。目前的主要瓶頸在於流程對齊，我們已經提出對應的改善機制來避免重複發生。
speaker_notes.en: We didn't just look at surface issues, but dug into the root causes. The main bottleneck lies in process alignment, and we've proposed corresponding mechanisms to prevent recurrence.

slide_title.zh: 下階段三大優先任務與所需支援 (Next Steps)

zh: 下月優先一：聚焦完成 [核心專案]，確保於 [日期] 上線
下月優先二：優化現有 [作業流程]，預計提升 [X]% 效率
需要主管支援：請求協調 [跨部門資源 / 預算審批 / 人力補充]
en: Priority 1: Focus on delivering [Core Project] by [Date]
Priority 2: Optimize [Process] to improve efficiency by [X]%
Required Support: Request coordination for [Cross-dept resources / Budget / Headcount]

speaker_notes.zh: 接下來我們的精力會集中在這三個優先任務上。為了讓專案順利推動，希望主管能協助我們在跨部門資源分配上給予支持。
speaker_notes.en: Moving forward, our energy will be focused on these top priorities. To ensure smooth execution, we request management's support in cross-functional resource allocation.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份專業商務風格的『月度/季度工作進度匯報』簡報。採用簡潔商務風格。內容必須著重於：1. 結論先行與數據導向，2. 剖析問題的根本原因（Root Cause），3. 提出明確的下一步與所需支援。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，每字不超過一行，排版需清晰易讀。
prompt_template.en: Please create a professional 'Monthly/Quarterly Progress Report' presentation in English. Use a clean, corporate style. The content must focus on: 1. Conclusion-first and data-driven insights, 2. Root Cause analysis for issues, 3. Clear Next Steps and required support. Max 3 bullet points per slide, max one line per bullet point. Ensure clean and readable formatting.
